brief: A field of glowing, amorphous planes floats across the screen, exhibiting a continuous, mesmerizing movement. While the shapes maintain their glowing nature, the visual focus is on the contrast between the planes, which transition from soft, diffuse edges to regions with sharper definition. As the shapes drift and reform, the boundaries become more clearly articulated, creating a dynamic play between organic softness and geometric sharpness. The experience is purely observational, requiring no input.

statement: This sketch creates an ever-shifting field of glowing, amorphous planes that drift across the screen with a mesmerizing rhythm. Each plane maintains its soft, luminous quality while gradually shifting from diffuse edges to more defined geometric forms through subtle distortions and transformations. The planes transition between shapes—ellipses, rectangles, and triangles—while floating in synchronized yet independent motion patterns. Their colors shift subtly in hue over time, creating a continuous visual narrative of organic softness and emerging geometric clarity. The effect is purely observational, requiring no input from the viewer as the planes continuously evolve through their own internal dynamics and interactions with each other.
